prompts.world: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D pixel-art scenery for a cozy idle exploration game, a finished production raster background. Landscape 3:2 composition. True crisp pixel clusters, limited hand-chosen palette, clean silhouettes, lovingly detailed retro RPG environment, no blur or painterly brush strokes. No text, letters, numbers, labels, HUD, border, watermark or characters. Grounded storybook fantasy, calm and inviting, not sinister. Readable at 900px width. Primary request: a top-down illustrated world map of one compact island. Five visibly connected regions along a winding pale footpath: lush moss woodland in the southwest, blue crystal cave and lake in the northwest, violet ruined observatory in the center, golden windmill fields in the southeast, snowy mountain temple in the northeast. A small tent camp at the very bottom-left shore. Rivers, small wooden bridges, rocky cliffs and charming landmarks. Regions blend naturally. Keep landmark centers near normalized positions (0.17,0.70), (0.29,0.31), (0.51,0.51), (0.73,0.70), (0.83,0.25); path connects them in that order. Fill the image with the island, a little teal water around the edge.
